verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services SaaS platform, and such a product could plausibly offer outbound event webhooks, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only email alerts, reminders, postcards and in-dashboard notifications for mail and compliance events. These are adjacent notification features and do not count as registrable HTTP callbacks for a programmatic consumer. No webhook or API event-subscription capability is documented anywhere in the pack.
